text: On the crew's fourth morning at Mirage Mangroves, they woke to find that the island had disappeared. A fog had rolled in overnight, so thick and white that from the deck of the Soggy Biscuit you couldn't see the end of the gangplank. Mo was standing at the little stove on deck, stirring a pot of porridge so thick that the spoon stood up by itself. Every so often it gave a slow, heavy bloop. Wren and Zed set off along the boardwalk to check on the Creatures. After ten steps, the boat behind them had vanished. Back on board, Wren started writing about it in her diary. Her first sentence said the fog was as thick as pea soup. Indi read it over her shoulder and said, 'That's a cliché.
